ios.desc:
Discover everything happening in Canberra with Events Canberra - your personal guide to the best events in the ACT.

• Browse Events - Explore hundreds of local events including markets, festivals, exhibitions, concerts, and community gatherings
• Smart Filters - Find events by category, date, or location. Filter for free events or hide long-running exhibitions
• AI-Powered Search - Ask natural questions like "What's happening this weekend?" or "Find free family events near me"
• Weather Forecasts - See weather conditions for outdoor events so you can plan ahead
• Save Favourites - Like events to build your personal calendar of things to do
• Map View - See all events on a map and discover what's happening nearby
• Review New Events - Swipe through new events Tinder-style to quickly find what interests you
• Personalised Recommendations - Get notified about events similar to ones you've liked
• Calendar Integration - Add events directly to your calendar with one tap
• Multiple App Icons - Choose from 10 unique Canberra-themed icons including Parliament House, the Carillon, and local favourites

Data sourced from events.canberra.com.au - supporting local event organisers and venues across the ACT.

This is an unofficial app made by a local Canberran whom does not any affiliation or association with the ACT Government or the Events Canberra website.
